entities.name: Cyril Rav
entities.description: A necro-alchemist from Innistrad whose geist-bomb turned him into a possessing geist.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where Cyril Rav lived and where geists now haunt the living.

entities.name: Millicent
entities.description: A powerful and angry geist who lost her life because of Cyril's machinations.

entities.name: Jacob Hauken
entities.description: A detective who investigated the geist attacks.

entities.name: Eloise Wicker
entities.description: Jacob Hauken's associate, who was possessed by a geist.

entities.name: Lord Nellick
entities.description: A wealthy and influential merchant suspected of being linked to the geist attacks; Cyril Rav possessed his body.

events.summary: Cyril Rav's use of a geistbomb causes a catastrophic incident that kills many people and leaves malevolent geists such as Millicent.
events.quote: resulted in a catastrophic incident, killing many people and causing widespread destruction

events.summary: Jacob Hauken and Eloise Wicker investigate the geist attacks and uncover the connection to Cyril Rav.
events.quote: leading them to uncover the connection between the geists and Cyril Rav

events.summary: Jacob learns that Cyril Rav had possessed Nellick's body and tried to move into Jacob's own.
events.quote: Cyril Rav had possessed Nellick's body and attempted to move his spirit into Jacob's own

events.summary: Cyril offers Jacob a deal to work together, and Jacob agrees.

relations.quote: The detective Jacob Hauken and his associate Eloise Wicker investigated these geist attacks
